shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- next docs matches ---'; rg -n \"forbidden\\(|forbidden\\.js|auth boundary|unauthorized\\(\" node_modules/next/dist/docs -g '*.md' -g '*.mdx' | sed -n '1,200p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- AGENTS ---'; cat AGENTS.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- auth ---'; sed -n '1,240p' app/lib/auth.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- layout ---'; sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- page ---'; sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- config ---'; cat next.config.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- forbidden function docs ---'; sed -n '1,230p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/forbidden.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- forbidden file docs ---'; sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/forbidden.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- authInterrupts docs ---'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/authInterrupts.md 2>/dev/null || rg -n \"title: authInterrupts|authInterrupts\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config -g '*.md'"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/admin-headers.txt -o /tmp/admin-body.html http://localhost:3000/admin && sed -n '1,20p' /tmp/admin-headers.txt && printf '%s\\n' '--- body checks ---' && rg -o \"403|Access denied|This area is for administrators\" /tmp/admin-body.html | sort -u && printf '%s\\n' '--- git diff ---' && git diff -- app/admin/page.tsx app/forbidden.tsx app/globals.css app/layout.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json"
